name: work-brief-builder
description: Turn an unclear request into a focused, reviewable work brief with explicit scope, inputs, assumptions, and acceptance criteria.

interface.longDescription: Shape an unclear request into a practical brief that makes the intended outcome, boundaries, inputs, open questions, and review conditions visible before work begins.
defaultPrompt: Turn my request into a clear work brief.
Help me identify what is missing from this brief.
Show me a fictional before-and-after example.
